title: White Dining Table
desc: A white-green long table banquet and welcome table: anthurium, orchids and pompon mums over cream linens, candles in glass cylinders.

groups.label: Feature flowers
groups.blurb: The white-green arrangement running down the table and welcome mirror.

items.role: White anthurium standing tall above the arrangement (the sculptural white spathes).
White branching larkspur spikes adding vertical lift (form-match for large white delphinium).
White pompon mums as the round ball faces in the garland.
White roses through the table garland and welcome mirror piece.
White ranunculus layered into the low clusters.
White phalaenopsis sprays trailing over the table centre.
White oncidium orchids arching through the garland.
White hydrangea massing along the table line.
Light green hydrangea accents in the garland (form-match for the green ball tones).

groups.label: Greenery & trailing
groups.blurb: The greens that run the length of the table.

items.role: Eucalyptus sprigs through the garland base.
Fountain grass plumes softening the line.
Beaded trailing strings draping over the table edge (form-match trailing beaded green).
Dark green pine spray giving needle texture.
Fine-leaf asparagus fern filling the garland body (form-match for the fine asparagus foliage).

groups.label: Table styling
groups.blurb: The cream linens and candlelight of the banquet.

items.role: Cream satin tablecloth draping the long table with side bows.

White pillar candles lit inside the tall glass cylinders (glass cylinder holders themselves are a logged gap; napkins, black bamboo chairs, oak barrels and the arched welcome mirror are venue pieces).
